upload.title: Raw/Script Upload
upload.heading: Raw/Script Upload Assessment
upload.desc: Upload a SecuMS raw SQLite DB or Script XML. Script XML is used only as collected evidence (raw evidence), not as judgment results; AI or LLM makes verdicts based on its output.
upload.fileNote: At least one is required. If both are uploaded, SecuMS raw and Script raw evidence are assessed together.
upload.engAiLlm: AI then LLM (default · mock verdict + LLM 2nd pass)
upload.alertNoFile: Select at least one Raw DB or Script XML file.
upload.runningMsg: Assessment is running. AI is quick; LLM may take longer depending on settings and network conditions.

validate.title: Consistency Validation
validate.heading: Consistency Validation — Assessment
validate.desc: Compares the consistency of the KISA 30-rule assessment results with the original SecuMS assessment results. SecuMS checks 64 of its own items, so only some mapped items are directly comparable.
validate.scopeDesc: SecuMS checks 64 of its own items (os-linux-XXX), while this system checks the 30 core items of the KISA guide (U-01 ~ U-30). They check the same areas under different classifications, so item counts are not directly comparable.
validate.evalLlmWarn: ⚠ Arbitrary mock LLM verdicts — connect Ollama/a real LLM in production
validate.evalNote: LLM-evaluated rules do not analyze real data in mock mode. Switching to production mode with LLM_PROVIDER=ollama etc. enables accurate verdicts.
validate.verifiedTitle: Verified Mappings (confirmed via SecuMS BAD messages in raw DB)
validate.verifiedDesc: Items confirmed via ITEM/MSG analysis of SecuMS BAD results to check the same area as KISA U-XX. The match rate of assumed mappings (marked ? in the mapping table) may vary depending on whether the checked areas actually match.
validate.ruleTitle: Per-Rule Consistency Comparison (KISA U-XX ↔ SecuMS CHK_ID)
validate.verifiedTip: Mapping confirmed via raw DB MSG
validate.waitDesc: Items included in the SecuMS policy but not actually collected. No result data in the raw DB, so comparison is impossible.
validate.unmappedTitle: SecuMS BAD Not Mapped to KISA 30 Rules ({n})
validate.unmappedDesc: Items SecuMS judged vulnerable but not mapped to the KISA 30 scope. Consider extending the ruleset if operational policy needs to cover them.
